# Japan Astronomical Heritage

is an initiative aimed at the recognition and valorization of the astronomical heritage of Japan. Analogous to the International Astronomical Union's  of , the first assets were designated by the  in March 2019 (FY2018); as of March 2026 (FY2025), twenty entries are on the list. Three categories are recognized: sites (historic sites and buildings, such as observatories), materials (historically significant items, such as astronomical instruments), and documents (including historic astronomy-related literature).
